Local Ordinance 99-4 Obstruction of Officers

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, AND IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED BY AUTHORITY OF SAME, AS FOLLOWS:

A person who knowingly and willfully obstructs or hinders any law enforcement officer in the lawful discharge of his official duties is guilty of a misdemeanor.

Rate Schedule:

Ist Offense $1,172.00 2nd Offense $1,750.00 + 40 hours community service

APPROVED AND ADOPTED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, THIS THE 11TH DAY OF JANUARY, 2010.
